text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about with
Vodka...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Over there! Check out that claw
machine!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vodka points toward a claw machine
filled with
Umamusume plushies.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I didn't know they made stuff like this!
That's so
cool!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
There're so many! And they've really
captured
everyone's characteristics!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Don't get the wrong idea, though.
There's no
way I'd be interested in
plushies!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She may say that, but Vodka seems
clearly
interested in the claw machine.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
choice_data_list: Shall I get it for you?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If you really wanna... I'll take any
plushies off your
hands if ya win, so ya
might as well give it a shot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can fail now!
